falseFriends.actual: Use 'Ist-' prefix (Ist-Wert, Ist-Geschwindigkeit) or 'tatsächlich', not 'aktuell' (which means 'current/recent'). The Ist/Soll distinction is fundamental to German engineering.
falseFriends.performance: Use 'Leistungsgrad' (VDMA 66412) or 'Leistung', not 'Performance' or 'Performanz' (anglicisms). 'Performance' signals unlocalised software to German manufacturing professionals.
falseFriends.eventually: Use 'schließlich' or 'letztendlich', not 'eventuell' (which means 'possibly'). Critical in production reports.
falseFriends.billion: Use 'Milliarde' (10^9), not 'Billion' (which means 10^12 in German long scale). Critical for production volumes and financial reporting.
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'Ausschuss' (quality rejects/inspection failures), not 'Schrott' (metal scrap for recycling). 'Schrott' implies parts going to melting, not failing QA inspection.
falseFriends.station: Use 'Arbeitsstation' or 'Arbeitsplatz' for manufacturing workstation. 'Station' alone evokes Bahnhof/Polizeistation in German.
falseFriends.idle: Use 'Leerlauf' (running idle, no-load) or 'Wartezeit' (waiting time), not 'faul' (lazy, strongly pejorative) or 'untätig' (inactive, sounds unnatural for equipment).
falseFriends.rate: In OEE context use 'Takt', 'Geschwindigkeit', or 'Quote'. German 'Rate' primarily means installment payment. 'Qualitätsrate' is the established German OEE term — but here 'Rate' is German, not an English cognate.
falseFriends.effective: Use 'Gesamtanlageneffektivität' for OEE, not generic 'Effektivität' alone. 'Wirksam/Wirksamkeit' for general effectiveness. 'Effektiv' exists but is overused as anglicism.
falseFriends.setup: Use 'Rüsten' / 'Rüstvorgang' / 'Rüstzeit' for manufacturing changeover setup. Not 'Setup' (anglicism) or 'Einrichtung' (permanent installation).

grammarNotes.compoundWords: German forms compounds aggressively: Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE), Zykluszeit (cycle time), Geschwindigkeitsverlust (speed loss), Stillstandsgrund (stop reason), Produktionssignal (production signal). Never split with spaces — this is a severe error immediately visible to native speakers.
grammarNotes.caseSystem: Four cases (Nominative, Accusative, Dative, Genitive). UI labels use nominative: 'Verfügbarkeit', 'Leistungsgrad'. Instructional text must match case to grammatical role: 'Berechnen Sie die Verfügbarkeit' (accusative).
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Every noun has gender affecting articles: 'die Verfügbarkeit' (f), 'der Leistungsgrad' (m), 'die Qualität' (f), 'die Zykluszeit' (f), 'der Stillstand' (m), 'die Schicht' (f), 'der Ausschuss' (m). Compounds inherit final component gender: 'Zykluszeit' (f) from 'Zeit' (f).
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma (,). Thousands: period (.) or non-breaking space. 'OEE von 85,5%'. '1.000 Einheiten'. DIN 5008: space before % is technically correct ('85,5 %') but '85,5%' common in software.
grammarNotes.nounCapitalization: German capitalizes ALL nouns including common nouns and compounds: 'Verfügbarkeit', 'Leistungsgrad', 'Qualitätsrate', 'Zykluszeit', 'Ausschuss'. Failing to capitalize is an immediately visible error. Adjectives lowercase: 'geplante Zeit'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: German compound words inherently use the singular stem for the modifier (Bestimmungswort). 'Geschwindigkeitsverlustgründe' correctly uses 'Geschwindigkeitsverlust-' (singular stem) + 'gründe' (plural head). No compound pluralization issue — correct by construction.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: Both OEE (English acronym) and GAE (Gesamtanlageneffektivität) are used. OEE is practitioner-dominant in software (SAP, Siemens, FORCAM). GAE appears in academic/consulting literature and VDI 3423. Practitioner preference: english_dominant.
industryContext.dominantVendors: SAP (HQ Walldorf, Germany), Siemens Opcenter, FORCAM ENISCO, MPDV, ISTOS, PSI
industryContext.industrie40: Germany coined 'Industrie 4.0' (Hannover Messe 2011). Vocabulary: 'Digitale Fabrik', 'Cyber-physisches System', 'Plattform Industrie 4.0', 'Digitaler Zwilling'. OEE is the 'Königsindikator der Fertigung' (king metric of manufacturing).
industryContext.automotiveContext: VDA (Verband der Automobilindustrie) requires OEE measurement at supplier facilities. IATF 16949 mandates OEE. German Mittelstand SMEs increasingly adopt OEE via Industrie 4.0 initiatives.

commonMistakes: Using 'Performance' or 'Performanz' instead of 'Leistungsgrad' — VDMA 66412 defines 'Leistungsgrad' as the OEE performance component
Using 'aktuell' where 'Ist-' or 'tatsächlich' is needed — 'Ist-Wert' vs 'Soll-Wert' is fundamental to German engineering language
Not capitalizing German nouns: 'verfügbarkeit' should be 'Verfügbarkeit', 'leistungsgrad' should be 'Leistungsgrad'
Splitting compound words: 'Zykluszeit' not 'Zyklus Zeit'; 'Geschwindigkeitsverlust' not 'Geschwindigkeits Verlust'
Using 'Schrott' instead of 'Ausschuss' for production quality rejects — 'Schrott' is metal scrap for recycling
Inconsistently using 'Ausfallzeit' vs 'Stillstandszeit' for downtime — standardize on 'Ausfallzeit' per DIN EN 13306
notes: OEE acronym is practitioner-dominant in German manufacturing software; full German term is Gesamtanlageneffektivität (GAE). Use formal 'Sie' form. Avoid anglicisms where German equivalents exist (Leistungsgrad not Performance, Ausschuss not Schrott, Rüstzeit not Setup-Zeit). German compounds must never be split with spaces. All nouns capitalized. VDI 3423, VDMA 66412, and DIN EN 13306 define the German manufacturing terminology framework.
